::: {#def-rule-of-inference}
#### Rule of inference

A **rule of inference**
is an argument form whose premises logically entail its conclusion (@def-logical-entailment),
whatever propositions (@def-proposition) are put in it.
It is written with its premises above a line and its conclusion below:
$$
\frac{P_1, \ldots, P_n}{Q}.
$$

:::
